notes: The library says TAG members must fill out a work permit. Pokemon card game helpers meet Thursdays 5 to 6 PM starting October 1.
name: Teen Advisory Group and teen volunteer roles (Ypsilanti District Library)
what_you_do: Teen Advisory Group members plan teen events. They lead them, write grants and talk to youth groups. Other roles are event helper and teen librarian aide (waitlist). Grades 10 to 12 can start their own project.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 18. Create Your Own Project is for grades 10 to 12. The page gives no grade rule for the Teen Advisory Group.
duration: Teen Librarian Assistant: one hour weekly or every other week
deadline_text: No deadlines are listed. All Teen Librarian Assistant spots were filled, so the form puts you on a waitlist.
how_to_apply: Use the TAG application, the event volunteer sign-up form or the project proposal form linked on the page. Phone: 734-482-4110.
